A '''dock warehouse''' in the capital of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] was the site of a shootout between [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|police]] and [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Royal Guard]] led by [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] and [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] smugglers led by [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]].

After the shootout, the police burned the warehouse and the smuggled [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|contents]] within with [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]].
